The questions you're already asking.

What is the hormonal gut and why does it matter for my cycle?
The hormonal gut is a specific group of bacteria whose job is to help your body process estrogen across your cycle. When estrogen shifts through your cycle — and especially during the hormonal changes that come with your 30s, 40s, and beyond — those bacteria can have trouble keeping up. Digestion can slow, water can retain, and the bloat that lives on Day 22 shows up. The Gut Gummy is the first tribiotic gummy formulated to support that specific system.
How is this different from other bloat gummies?
Most bloat products are formulated for general bloating — food sensitivity, occasional gas, post-meal pressure. The Gut Gummy is formulated for hormonal bloating that follows your cycle. Different strains, different mechanism, different audience. If you've tracked your bloat and it's calendar-shaped, you're in the right place.
How many gummies a day, and when?
Two gummies a day, with your morning routine. Same time every day, through every phase. Consistency through the full 28-day cycle is what allows the hormonal gut to rebuild.
When will I notice a difference?
Most cycle-aware users feel some reduction in luteal-phase bloating by their first full cycle. The bigger shift happens by cycle two or three, when the hormonal gut has had time to rebuild.
Is it safe to take with my other supplements?
The Gut Gummy is food-sourced, sugar-free, and formulated to be gentle on the system. As with any supplement, check with your healthcare provider if you have specific health concerns or are taking medications.
What's in the Subscribe & Save cycle?
One jar (60 gummies / one full cycle) ships every 30 days. 25% off, free shipping, skip or cancel anytime from your account. No penalties, no phone calls.
What's the 30-Day Cycle Guarantee?

Yes to both. Sugar-free because feeding bad bacteria is the opposite of the goal. Suitable for vegetarians. Full ingredient list on the nutrition label.
